de: Besuchen Sie das Haden Hill House & Park; der Eintritt in die historischen Gebäude und den Park ist oft kostenlos.
Erkunden Sie das Black Country Living Museum im nahegelegenen Dudley, um die Wurzeln der Kettenherstellung zu verstehen.
Nutzen Sie die Markttage (Di, Mi, Fr, Sa), um die authentische Atmosphäre des Cradley Heath Market zu erleben.
Der Bahnhof Cradley Heath bietet direkte Zugverbindungen nach Birmingham und Worcester.
Achten Sie auf die viktorianische Architektur in den Seitenstraßen, die Zeugnis der industriellen Blütezeit ist.
hu: Látogasd meg a Haden Hill House-t és parkját; a belépés a történelmi épületekbe és a kertbe is gyakran ingyenes.
Menj át a közeli Dudley-ba a Black Country Living Museumba, hogy megértsd a helyi lánckészítés történetét.
Vásárolj a piaci napokon (kedd, szerda, péntek, szombat) a Cradley Heath Marketen az igazi helyi élményért.
A vasútállomásról közvetlen vonatok indulnak Birminghamba és Worcesterbe, így könnyen felfedezheted a környéket.
Figyeld meg a mellékutcák viktoriánus építészetét, amely a város ipari fénykoráról mesél.
ro: Vizitați Haden Hill House & Park; accesul în clădirile istorice și în parc este de cele mai multe ori gratuit.
Mergeți la Black Country Living Museum în Dudley pentru a descoperi istoria fascinantă a fabricării lanțurilor.
Vizitați piața locală în zilele de marți, miercuri, vineri sau sâmbătă pentru o atmosferă autentică.
Gara Cradley Heath oferă legături feroviare directe către Birmingham și Worcester.
Admirați arhitectura victoriană de pe străzile secundare, o moștenire a perioadei de prosperitate industrială.
en: Visit Haden Hill House & Park; entry to the historic houses and the beautiful grounds is often free of charge.
Explore the Black Country Living Museum in nearby Dudley to understand the town's world-famous chain-making heritage.
Make sure to visit on market days (Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday) for the real local atmosphere at Cradley Heath Market.
Cradley Heath railway station provides direct and frequent links to both Birmingham and Worcester.
Look out for the Victorian architecture in the side streets, which tells the story of the area's industrial past.

de.name: Grey Peas and Bacon
de.tip: Ein klassisches Gericht aus dem Black Country, das oft in traditionellen Cafés oder beim Metzger serviert wird.

de.name: Faggots and Peas
de.tip: Diese herzhafte Fleischspezialität ist ein typisches Arbeiteressen der Region; am besten auf dem Markt probieren.

de.name: Black Country Pork Scratchings
de.tip: Suchen Sie in lokalen Kiosken nach handgefertigten Schweinekrusten, sie sind hier besonders knusprig.

hu.name: Grey Peas and Bacon
hu.tip: Egy igazi Black Country-beli különlegesség, amit gyakran 'Groaty Dick'-nek is hívnak; keresd a hagyományos kifőzdékben.

hu.name: Faggots and Peas
hu.tip: Ez a fűszeres húsgombóc borsópürével igazi munkásétel, a helyi piacon a legfinomabb.

hu.name: Black Country Pork Scratchings
hu.tip: Keresd a helyi márkájú tepertőt a kisboltokban, ez a környék egyik leghíresebb sós rágcsálnivalója.

ro.name: Grey Peas and Bacon
ro.tip: Un preparat clasic din regiunea Black Country, servit adesea în cafenelele tradiționale sau măcelării.

ro.name: Faggots and Peas
ro.tip: Această mâncare tradițională consistentă este specifică zonei; merită încercată la tarabele din piață.

ro.name: Black Country Pork Scratchings
ro.tip: Căutați jumările de porc artizanale în magazinele locale; sunt o gustare celebră în această regiune.

en.name: Grey Peas and Bacon
en.tip: A Black Country staple, often known locally as 'Groaty Dick'; find it in traditional cafes or butchers.

en.name: Faggots and Peas
en.tip: A traditional hearty worker's meal often found in local market stalls or traditional eateries.

en.name: Black Country Pork Scratchings
en.tip: Look for locally produced pork scratchings in small shops; they are a world-famous local snack.

de.name: Cradley Heath Market

de.name: High Street
de.tip: Hier finden Sie noch viele traditionsreiche Familienbetriebe und Fachgeschäfte.

hu.name: Cradley Heath Market
hu.tip: Hagyományos fedett piac, ahol friss helyi árut, rövidárut és igazi közösségi hangulatot találsz.

hu.name: High Street
hu.tip: A főutcán még számos régi családi vállalkozást és különleges szaküzletet fedezhetsz fel.

ro.name: Cradley Heath Market
ro.tip: O piață interioară tradițională cu produse locale și o atmosferă primitoare, specifică zonei.

ro.name: High Street
ro.tip: Strada principală unde puteți găsi încă multe afaceri de familie cu o istorie îndelungată.

en.name: Cradley Heath Market
en.tip: A traditional indoor market with local produce, haberdashery, and a friendly community feel.

en.name: High Street
en.tip: Home to many long-standing family businesses and independent specialist shops.

de.name: Haden Hill Park

de.name: Bumble Hole Nature Reserve

hu.name: Haden Hill Park
hu.tip: Gyönyörűen gondozott park öreg fákkal és egy festői tóval a központ közelében.

ro.name: Haden Hill Park

en.name: Bumble Hole Nature Reserve
